job.description:
About Us


At the RENAISSANCE BORDEAUX, we don't just offer a place to stay; we provide a lifestyle experience that transcends ordinary hospitality. Discover our world of luxury and innovation. Nestled in the heart of the vibrant city, our lifestyle hotel is a hub of creativity, hosting unique events and private shows featuring celebrities. We are currently seeking a passionate and experienced Assistant Front Office Manager to join our leadership team and help shape exceptional guest journeys.



Responsibilities


As Assistant Front Office Manager, reporting directly to the Front Office Manager, you will act as a key leader of the department, ensuring smooth operations and a high standard of service. Your main responsibilities include:


  • Supporting the Front Office Manager in overseeing the daily front office operations, including Reception, Guest Services, and Night Audit.
  • Leading and supervising shifts with a strong presence on the floor to foster guest satisfaction and team engagement.
  • Managing the team’s performance, coaching and training them to ensure continuous development and excellence.
  • Ensuring that brand standards and service expectations are consistently met or exceeded.
  • Handling guest feedback and resolving operational challenges with professionalism and care.
  • Coordinating closely with other departments (Housekeeping, F&B, Engineering, Sales) to create seamless guest experiences.



Qualifications


To thrive in this role, you should possess:


  • A strong background in front office operations within a lifestyle or premium hotel (minimum 2 years in a supervisory or assistant management role).
  • Proven leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and empower a multicultural team.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with strong attention to detail.
  • A guest-centric mindset and genuine passion for hospitality.
  • Confidence in handling guest relations and operational decision-making.
  • Fluent French and English required; additional languages are a plus.
  • Proficiency with hotel management systems
